name: io.github.Luz7818/flowdeck
title: FlowDeck
description: Render AI coding plans as an editable canvas; returns the user-confirmed plan as JSON + Markdown.

environmentVariables.name: FLOWDECK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Preferred canvas host port; default 7688, falls back to a free port when busy or reserved

environmentVariables.name: FLOWDECK_NO_OPEN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable auto-opening the browser (the canvas URL is printed to stderr)

environmentVariables.name: FLOWDECK_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Confirmation wait timeout in milliseconds; default 600000, set to 0 to disable the limit; on timeout the tool returns cancelled
